title: Implement and regress Ready continuity, app-switch, pause/issue and timer recovery
prompt: P0 continuation after usage reset. Work from the ACTUAL current Ready branch HEAD, which may already contain whole-foundation-a-v1. First inspect existing session/timer/handoff/runtime code and preserve all current First Journey, character, parent/planner and manual-result changes. Implement the READY WHOLE CONTRACT continuity boundary without inventing new product roles. Hard semantics: Ready remains the single session state owner; APP_SWITCH != PAUSE, != LAP_END, != SESSION_END; SCREEN_LOCK/BACKGROUND != PAUSE; NETWORK LOSS != SESSION_END; TASK_CHANGE = LAP_END + NEXT_LAP_START; Recording != Pause != Issue; System Wait is not child Issue and is excluded from Focus time according to existing Ready master. Authoritative timer must be timestamp-derived; setInterval/requestAnimationFrame are display refresh only. Returning from Safari/background/BFCache, unrelated app switch, Hide & Seek, Snap & Pop, recording flow, safe reload/recovery must restore the SAME session/task/lap/target/start timing context and must not require the child to press Start again. Preserve session_id, goal_id, task_id, lap_id, target_time/targetAt, session_start_at/startAt, pause intervals/state, issue state and return_target across specialist handoff. Add explicit state/version/provenance only where needed; avoid duplicate competing session stores. Offline/local execution must continue; reconnect/sync is downstream and must not block timer. Existing active Focus must not be force-reloaded by schedule/update changes. Add bounded deterministic regression tests/harness covering: focus start -> simulated background/elapsed wall time -> resume; explicit pause vs background; ISSUE vs System Wait; Ready->Hide->Ready and Ready->Snap->Ready state roundtrip; task switch lap transition; offline/reconnect; BFCache/pageshow; safe restore; no duplicate session/event creation. Where browser/iOS behavior cannot be truly proven headlessly, mark DEVICE_UNVERIFIED rather than PASS. Lock-screen visibility itself is ADR/native-enhancement and must NOT be faked as implemented; only continuity while locked/backgrounded can be implemented/tested in PWA core. Do not deploy/release, do not touch main, paid generation, GPS/location, Snap rewards/growth/Wish Shop, or WEEK/DAY visual design. Run node syntax/tests and existing relevant regressions. Finish with exact changed files, tests, recovered pre-existing behavior vs newly fixed behavior, remaining iPhone-only checks, and any architectural blocker. Actual repository edits are required unless inspection proves the complete behavior already exists, in which case add a bounded regression harness/evidence doc so this task still produces auditable changes.
